tools.name: deal_scan
tools.description: FREE. Postcode district (England & Wales): top 3 streets where recent Land Registry sales sit well below the district median for the same property type.

tools.name: deal_scan_full
tools.description: PRO. Full below-median street list for one or more districts (up to 5) plus individual sales under 60% of the same-type median, with addresses.

tools.name: planning_nearby
tools.description: PRO. Recent planning applications for the council covering a postcode (from planning.data.gov.uk).

tools.name: epc_hints
tools.description: PRO. EPC bands at the postcodes of the top below-median streets in a district — low bands (E–G) flag refurb / value-add potential.
